title: Space Force people ask about Hawkeye 360 detecting UAP signals at SCU

tellings.quote: went there in 2022 and people associated with space force from three-letter agencies came off to me and talk to me about applying Hawkeye abilities to just looking for UAP signals on the ground

plain: In 2022, at a meeting of the Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies in Huntsville, Alabama (UAP, or unidentified anomalous phenomena, is the government's newer term for UFOs), people tied to the Space Force, the US military's space branch, and to intelligence agencies approached Bob Maguire about using the abilities of Hawkeye 360 to look for UAP signals on the ground. Maguire, a former CIA contractor, says this happened to him directly. If true, it would mean military people were quietly looking for ways to track such objects.
